# 1. Import all processed data

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(kableExtra)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)

source(here::here("R","trip_functions.R"))

load(here::here("data","NewlyCreatedData",
                "loc_clean_interp2rouzic2005-2019.RData"))
load(here::here("data","NewlyCreatedData",
                "loc_clean_interp6_rouzic23.RData"))
load(here::here("data","NewlyCreatedData",
                "loc_clean_interp_rouzic2022.RData"))


rouz05.19<-loc.clean.interp.rouzic05.19 %>% 
    mutate(year=year(datetime)) %>% 
    dplyr::select(year,id,datetime,long,lat,
                  distmax,distadj,totalpath,travelNb,trip.id)


rouz23<-loc.clean.interp.rouzic23 %>% 
     mutate(year=year(datetime)) %>% 
    dplyr::select(year,id,datetime,long,lat,
                  distmax,distadj,totalpath,travelNb,trip.id)

rouz22<-loc.interp.rouzic %>% 
     mutate(year=year(datetime)) %>% 
    dplyr::select(year,id,datetime,long,lat,
                  distmax,distadj,totalpath,travelNb,trip.id)


rouz.all<-rbind(rouz05.19,rouz22,rouz23) 


#select borders
target<-c("France","United Kingdom","Spain","Belgium",
          "Netherlands", "Germany","Ireland","Isle of Man",
          "Jersey" ,"Guernsey"  ,"Åland")  

coord_rouzic<-colo_coord_rouzic %>% 
    sf::st_as_sf(., coords = c("long","lat"))


 indisf<-rouz.all %>%
     mutate(year=factor(as.factor(year),
                        levels=c(2023,2022,2019,2017,2016,2015,2014,
                                 2013,2012, 2011,2010, 2006,2005)) )
     
 
 #contours of countries
shp<-ne_countries(scale = 10, returnclass = 'sf') %>%
    dplyr::filter(name %in% target) 

#coastlines
coast<-ne_coastline(scale = 10, returnclass = "sf") 
  
    #create external files
tiff(here::here("outputs","Clean_trips_2005-2023.png"),
        width=4000,height=3000,res=400,
     compression="lzw")

   #Map of all locations for 1 ind
   map<-ggplot()+
            geom_path(data = indisf,
            aes(x=long,y=lat,
                group=year,
                color=year),
                 show.legend = T) +
       geom_sf(data=shp,fill="grey90") +
           geom_sf(data = coord_rouzic,
            shape=23, 
            colour="black",
            fill="yellow", 
            size=4) + 
        coord_sf(xlim=c(-9,2),
             ylim=c(46.8,52.0),
             expand=F) +
   scale_colour_manual(values=turbo(13),  name="Year") +
       labs(x="",y="") +
     annotation_scale(location = "br",
                     width_hint = 0.15,
                     pad_x = unit(0.7, "cm"),
                     bar_cols = "black") +
    annotation_north_arrow(location = "br",
                           which_north = "true",
                           style = ggspatial::north_arrow_nautical(),
                           pad_y = unit(0.8, "cm")) +
       theme_bw() 


print(map)

dev.off()

```
